_comment: Starting points grounded in the emotional-speech-prosody literature (e.g. Yildirim et al. 2004; Major & Chatterjee 2026 RAVDESS analysis; Fairbanks & Hoaglin 1941 on pause length) but not measured on YOUR narrator - tune every field by ear. breathiness/roughness/brightness are kept modest here on purpose: each is individually subtle, but stacked together (plus tempo/pause warping) they compound into an audible loss of harmonic clarity on loud/sustained vowels - push them up gradually and check a loud vowel, not just a quiet passage. Add a new mood by copying a block and giving it a new key; it shows up in the node's 'preset' dropdown after a ComfyUI restart (and, for the slider auto-fill in the UI, add the same values to web/mykee_emotion_timbre.js too). Fields: tempo_scale/pitch_range_scale/energy_range_scale in roughly [0.4, 2.0] (1.0 = unchanged), pitch_shift_semitones in [-12, 12], rate_variability in [0, 1], pause_scale in [0.3, 3.0] (1.0 = unchanged), breathiness/brightness in [-1, 1], roughness in [0, 1], vibrato_depth_semitones in [0, 1], vibrato_rate_hz in [1, 8].
